subject: english
title: 八上英语同步章节卷 · Units 1–2
label: Units 1–2 Happy Holiday · Home Sweet Home
unit: 八上·Units 1–2 Happy Holiday / Home Sweet Home
source: 人教版八年级上册 Unit 1 Happy Holiday、Unit 2 Home Sweet Home：一般过去时、不定代词（something / anything / nobody / everyone）、-ed 与 -ing 形容词、家务劳动、礼貌请求（Could you please ...?）、家与家乡。按八年级单元测试题型编写（不含听力），百分制

items.stem:
—Did you buy ______ for your parents in Hainan?
—Yes, I bought them some coconut candy.
items.exp: 一般疑问句中用 anything。坑点：表示请求、建议的问句（Would you like ...?）才用 something。

items.stem: There is ______ wrong with my bike. Could you help me fix it?
items.exp: 肯定句中用 something；后面请人帮忙修，说明有问题，不是 nothing。形容词放在不定代词后面。

items.stem: I knocked at the door, but ______ answered. Everyone was out.
items.exp: 大家都出去了，所以没人应门：nobody。

items.stem:
—How ______ your trip to Guilin?
—Wonderful! The mountains and rivers were so beautiful.
items.exp: 问过去的旅行，主语 your trip 是单数，用 was。

items.stem: I was so ______ about the trip that I couldn't sleep the night before.
items.exp: -ed 形容词描述人的感受，-ing 形容词描述事物的特点。人感到兴奋用 excited。

items.stem:
—Did you take any photos there?
—______ I left my camera at home.
items.exp: Did ...? 用 did / didn't 回答；相机落在家里，所以没拍。

items.stem: Could you please ______ the rubbish? It smells bad.
items.exp: take out the rubbish 倒垃圾。

items.stem:
—Could you please clean your room, Tony?
—______ I'll do it right now.
items.exp: Could you please ...? 是礼貌请求，同意用 Sure / Certainly / No problem。坑点：不用 Yes, I could 回答。

items.stem: My parents often ask me ______ my own clothes.
items.exp: ask sb. to do sth. 要求某人做某事。

items.stem: My brother and I share the housework ______ our parents.
items.exp: share sth. with sb. 和某人分担 / 分享某物。

items.stem: Home is where your family is. There is no place ______ home.
items.exp: There is no place like home. 没有地方比得上家。like 是介词“像”。

items.stem:
—I hate doing chores.
—But doing chores helps you learn to ______ yourself.
items.exp: look after oneself 照顾自己。

items.stem:
—What did you think of the movie?
—It was so ______ that I fell asleep.
items.exp: 电影本身无聊，用 boring；看得睡着了，不是 exciting。

items.stem: We had ______ great time at the beach last weekend.
items.exp: have a great / good time 玩得开心，固定搭配用 a。

items.stem: Every Spring Festival, my family goes back to my hometown. We ______ the house and put up couplets before the festival.
items.exp: Every Spring Festival 表示每年的习惯，用一般现在时；主语 we，用 clean。

sections.title: A Holiday at Home
sections.passage:
Last summer holiday, my parents were busy, so we didn't go (16). At first I was unhappy. All my friends went to interesting places, but I just stayed at home.
One day, my mom said, "Why don't you learn to do (17) chores this holiday?" I didn't like the idea, but I said yes. First, I learned to cook. My first meal was terrible — the soup was too (18) and the eggs were black! But my parents ate it all and said, "Not bad for the first time." I felt (19).
Then I learned to do the laundry and (20) the floor. It was not easy, and I was tired every evening. But slowly I got better at it. By the end of the holiday, I (21) cook three dishes.
I also found something interesting. When I helped at home, my parents had more (22) to rest. In the evenings, we often went for walks together and talked a lot. I felt much (23) to my parents.
This holiday was not exciting, but it was (24). I learned that home is not only a place to live. It is also a place where everyone (25) about each other and helps each other.

items.exp: 否定句中用 anywhere；didn't 已经表示否定，不能再用 nowhere。
Why don't you ...? 是建议，用 some；chores 可数，不能用 much。
第一顿饭很糟糕：汤太咸了。其他三项都是好的评价。
父母吃光了还夸“第一次不错”，我很开心。
家务：洗衣服、扫地 sweep the floor。
慢慢做得越来越好，假期结束时能做三个菜了：could 表示过去的能力。
我帮忙做家务，父母就有更多时间休息。
一起散步聊天，和父母更亲近：feel closer to sb.。
but 转折：不刺激，但很有意义。
care about each other 互相关心，与 helps each other 并列。

groups.title: Summer Holiday Tours
groups.passage:
Lijiang Tour: 5 days, ¥3,200 per person. Visit the Old Town and Jade Dragon Snow Mountain. Children under 12: half price.

items.stem: Which tour is the longest?
items.exp: 丽江 5 天，青岛 4 天，西安 3 天。

items.stem: How much does a 10-year-old child pay for the Lijiang tour?
Where can people ride a bike on the old city wall?
items.exp: Xi'an History Trip ... ride a bike on the old city wall。

items.stem: Mr. Wang and his wife want to go swimming in the sea. How much should they pay?
items.exp: 去海边是青岛线，每人 2500 元，两人 5000 元。

items.stem: What can people get if they book before June 30?
options: A free ticket to the Ocean Park.

groups.label: B
groups.title: Should Kids Do Chores at Home?
groups.passage:
Mrs. Green (mother): I think kids should help at home. Doing chores teaches them to look after themselves. My son is 13. He makes his bed, takes out the rubbish and feeds our cat every day.
Mr. Liu (father): My daughter is in Grade 8. She has lots of homework and gets home at 6 p.m. I don't want her to do chores on weekdays, but on weekends she helps me cook.
Jack (student): I didn't like doing chores at first. But last month my mom was ill in bed for a week, and I did all the shopping and cleaning. I found it was not so hard. Now I think everyone in the family should share the housework.
Ms. Chen (teacher): Kids who do chores often learn to be independent. But parents should give them chores that are right for their age.

items.stem: What does Mrs. Green's son do every day?
items.exp: He makes his bed, takes out the rubbish and feeds our cat every day。

items.stem: When does Mr. Liu's daughter help with the cooking?
items.exp: on weekends she helps me cook。

items.stem: Why did Jack do all the shopping and cleaning last month?
options: Because his father asked him to.
items.exp: my mom was ill in bed for a week。

items.stem: Who doesn't want the child to do chores on weekdays?
items.exp: Mr. Liu: I don't want her to do chores on weekdays。

items.stem: What does Ms. Chen think?
options: Parents should give kids chores that are right for their age.
Kids should do all the housework.
items.exp: parents should give them chores that are right for their age。

sections.title: Spring Festival in My Hometown
sections.passage:
This Spring Festival, my family (36) (drive) back to my grandparents' village. The trip (37) (take) us about six hours. When we got there, (38) (every) in the family was busy. Grandpa was putting up couplets on the door, and Grandma was making dumplings. I helped her (39) (make) dumplings, but mine looked (40) (fun).
On the eve of the Spring Festival, we had a big dinner together. There were many (41) (dish) on the table. After dinner, we watched the Spring Festival Gala and (42) (talk) until midnight.
I didn't have (43) (some) homework to do, so I played with my cousins every day. I really (44) (enjoy) myself. There is no place like home. I can't wait (45) (go) back next year!

items.exp: This Spring Festival 已经过去，drive 的过去式 drove。
It / The trip took sb. ... 花费某人多长时间；take 的过去式 took。
家里每个人都很忙；不定代词作主语，谓语用单数 was。
help sb. (to) do sth.。
look 是系动词，后接形容词；fun 的形容词“好笑的”是 funny，双写 n 加 -y。
many 后接复数；dish 以 sh 结尾，加 -es。
and 连接两个过去的动作，与 watched 一致。
否定句中 some 改为 any。
enjoy oneself 玩得开心，讲过去的事用 enjoyed。
can't wait to do sth. 迫不及待地做某事。

sections.prompt:
请以“My Last Holiday”为题，写一篇短文介绍你上一个假期：1. 你去了哪里（或待在家里），和谁一起；2. 你做了哪些事（至少三件，可以包括帮家里做的家务）；3. 你的感受和收获。要求：80 词左右，题目已给出，不计入总词数；文中不得出现真实姓名和校名。
My Last Holiday
points: 语言正确（一般过去时、不定代词、-ed / -ing 形容词），书写规范
sections.sample:
My Last Holiday
Last winter holiday, I didn't go anywhere far. I stayed in my hometown with my family, but I still had a great time.
First, I helped my parents clean the house before the Spring Festival. I swept the floor and cleaned the windows. Then I learned to make dumplings with my grandma. They didn't look nice, but they tasted delicious. I also read three books and went skating with my cousins.
It was not an exciting trip, but I felt very relaxed. I learned that doing something for my family makes me happy.
sections.exp: 写完检查：叙述假期全文用一般过去时（go→went、swim→swam、make→made、feel→felt）；“没去任何地方”是 didn't go anywhere；人感到……用 -ed 形容词（excited、relaxed），事物让人……用 -ing 形容词（exciting、relaxing）。
